misreports.text: Prints 'EXECUTABLE - cutover may broadcast now' for the whole [initiatedAt+6h, initiatedAt+78h]. In the last 6h (WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN) the cutover's Phase 0 refuses to start. Story 092's runbook step 2 uses this line as the go signal. Fail-safe (the cutover refuses loudly), so QA.

EXECUTABLE is printed regardless of strategy.paused(); 'strategy paused: true' is on a separate line. totalWithdrawal is whenNotPaused, so the cutover's execute would revert. Fail-safe, QA (folded into S-35-01).
